summary: Foresight Autonomous Holdings filed a Form 6-K furnishing a press release dated November 12, 2026, announcing completion of the integration of its 3D perception system into VisionWave's VARAN modular unmanned ground vehicle platform, following an August 2026 Strategic Cooperation Agreement. No transaction, securities issuance, or ownership change is disclosed; the release covers mechanical design, stereoscopic calibration, and planned live demonstrations for defense ministries in Europe, Asia, and North America, plus trade-show participation. This is an ordinary commercial/technology milestone, not a special situation; watch defense contract conversion rather than any arbitrage angle.
